name: RAFAEL PERINI VALLE
subtitle: SENIOR OPERATIONS ENGINEER
tagline: Shorebase Operations · Offshore Support · HSSE · Operational Readiness · Contractors · KPIs & Data

sections.title: Professional Summary
bullets: Operations-focused engineer with 4+ years in offshore/marine execution, shorebase coordination and O&G support in Brazil, including 3y5m as Marine Operations Superintendent.

Hands-on coordination of daily operations across vessel and shore interfaces, integrating offshore teams, terminals, maritime agents, local suppliers, contractors, clients and international management.

Strong HSSE and operational-performance background: operational risk, emergency response, incident investigation, troubleshooting, corrective actions, readiness, production/availability/downtime/fuel KPIs and 15-day forecasting.

Petrobras operational environment exposure through Drake/SAP RT, offshore logistics and FPSO/OSV support; Advanced Excel, Power BI and active development in SQL, Python and automation for data-driven operations.

sections.title: Core Expertise
sections.content: Shorebase Operations · Offshore / Onshore Interface · Daily Operations Coordination · Operational Readiness · Reliability & Operability · HSSE / QHSE · Operational Risk · Troubleshooting & Recovery Actions · Contractors / Vendors / Third Parties · Local Suppliers & Service Providers · Materials & Services Availability · Maintenance Campaigns · Mobilisation & Logistics · Inspections & Compliance · Operational Data / KPIs · Contract & Claims Interfaces · Stakeholder Management · Planning & Forecasting

lead.title: Professional Development & Independent Projects (Nov 2024–Present)
lead.body: Career-development period focused on data, digital tools and automation for operational decision-making: SQL, Python, HTML/CSS/JavaScript, structured data, dashboards and workflow automation. Completed postgraduate studies in Occupational Safety Engineering and remained active through independent digital and project-based work. Immediately available for full-time return.

entries.role: Marine Operations Superintendent (Daily Operations, HSSE & Performance)
bullets: Acted as the on-site operational focal point for daily marine execution across multiple Brazilian ports, coordinating vessel masters, shore teams, terminals, maritime agents, local suppliers, contractors, clients and project management.

Planned and controlled critical operating windows, mobilisations, berthing/unberthing, bunkering, crew change, waste handling and SIMOPS, resolving constraints to maintain safe and continuous operations.

Monitored production, vessel availability, downtime and fuel consumption; investigated operational deviations, validated survey/measurement inputs and drove corrective and recovery actions with vessel and project teams.

Led HSSE/QHSE operational controls including risk assessments, procedures, emergency response, 5+ real MEDEVAC cases, incident investigation, root-cause follow-up and corrective actions under NORMAM/IMO/ISM/SOLAS/MARPOL requirements.

Managed third-party and vendor interfaces for materials and services, operational support, measurements, costs and claims; maintained 15-day forecasts and management reporting for clients and international leadership.

entries.role: Operations Analyst (Offshore Operations, FPSO/OSV Support & Readiness)
bullets: Planned and monitored offshore maintenance and cleaning campaigns supporting OSVs and FPSOs, coordinating crews, materials, deadlines, readiness and daily execution follow-up.
Coordinated contractors and operational interfaces for Shell, Transocean and Helix, supporting mobilisation, materials/services availability, deliverables, measurements, costs and contract control.
Worked with Petrobras Drake/SAP RT for personnel compliance and offshore logistics; supported POB, qualification/certification control, helicopter logistics and DPR/RDO reporting.
Mapped internal processes and helped build procedures and document controls for ISO 9000 implementation, strengthening operational standardisation and continuous improvement.
Supported offshore and port operations through contractor mobilisation, transport requests, documentation, logistics control and Petrobras DRAKE credentialing for Tier-1 clients.
Spent 18 months onboard ultra-deepwater pre-salt drillships, translating SOPs and supporting technical, safety and operational communication across multinational offshore teams.
International engineering research involving structured data collection, technical analysis, testing support and multidisciplinary collaboration.
